requirements.item_text: Procedures exist for safely removing waste, including toxic chemical and biological waste, reagents, samples, solvents and air filters.

mappings.quote: Procedures should be in place for the safe removal of types of waste including toxic waste (chemical and biological), reagents, samples, solvents and air filters.

requirements.item_text: Antimicrobial waste from laboratory testing, though usually negligible next to manufacturing waste, is still considered in exceptional cases, such as when a QC laboratory tests very large sample quantities.

mappings.quote: The amount of antimicrobial waste being generated by laboratory testing activities is generally considered to be negligible compared to the amounts that are being generated by manufacturing activities but should still be considered in exceptional cases, e.g. if very large amounts of sample are being tested by a quality control laboratory.

requirements.item_text: API and finished product manufacturers consider keeping a risk assessment of all contaminants from antimicrobial manufacturing if released into the environment, including the risk of resistant microorganisms developing.

mappings.quote: manufacturers of APIs and FPPs should consider retaining documentation on the following: ■■ a risk assessment for all contaminants related to antimicrobial manufacturing, in the event that they are released into the environment, and the associated risk of development of resistant microorganisms

requirements.item_text: Based on that risk assessment, manufacturers consider keeping a waste-stream analysis for each antimicrobial produced, at API and finished product sites.

mappings.quote: based on the above risk assessment, waste-stream analysis for each antimicrobial agent produced (at API sites and FPP sites).

requirements.item_text: The waste-stream analysis is repeated whenever a production change affects waste streams.

mappings.quote: This analysis should be repeated whenever there is a change in production affecting waste streams

requirements.item_text: Manufacturers consider keeping records of the quantity and nature of waste generated, including analytical data, documented analyses and findings on levels of antimicrobials or their precursors.

mappings.quote: the quantity and nature of the waste generated, including the analytical data and documentation of analyses performed and their findings on the levels of antimicrobial agents or their precursors

requirements.item_text: Manufacturers consider keeping regular reports on collecting, treating and disposing of waste and wastewater, at a risk-based frequency consistent with applicable local, regional or international regulatory requirements.

mappings.quote: regular reports on the collection, treatment and disposal of waste and wastewater; the frequency should be risk-based and in line with local, regional or international regulatory requirements, as applicable

requirements.item_text: The waste treatment methods are documented as effective for each specific antimicrobial or antimicrobial precursor.

mappings.quote: information on the methods used to treat the waste should be documented to be effective for each specific antimicrobial or antimicrobial precursor.

requirements.item_text: Analytical data showing conversion of these substances and residues to non-hazardous waste are available at the facility and kept current.

mappings.quote: Analytical data demonstrating the conversion of these substances and their residues to non-hazardous waste materials should be available at the facility and kept up to date

requirements.item_text: If effective treatment is not yet in place for all waste streams from each API or finished product, a documented time-limited strategy with specified milestones sets out actions towards treatment that significantly reduces the antimicrobial or precursor concentration (and its microbial source, when relevant).

mappings.quote: if effective waste treatment is not yet implemented for all waste streams resulting from the manufacture of each API or FPP, documentation on a time-limited strategy should be in place, with specified milestones for that implementation, specifying actions towards achieving treatment that significantly reduces the concentration of the antimicrobial substance or its precursor (and its microbial source, when relevant)

requirements.item_text: Manufacturers consider keeping a rationale and risk assessment for their chosen decontamination methods for antimicrobial-containing manufacturing waste and/or their mitigation strategy.

mappings.quote: a rationale and risk assessment as to why the manufacturer selected specific methods of decontamination of manufacturing waste containing antimicrobials and/or their mitigation strategy

requirements.item_text: Incineration may be considered for solid or semi-liquid waste.

mappings.quote: Incineration may also be considered for solid or semi-liquid waste.

requirements.item_text: A zero-liquid effluent or zero-discharge approach is adopted, especially where the risk is assessed as high or unclear.

mappings.quote: The zero-liquid effluent approach or zero-discharge policy is encouraged, especially when the risk is assessed to be high or unclear, as it prevents any contamination of the environment.

requirements.item_text: The effectiveness and by-products of a treatment approach are considered when choosing it.

mappings.quote: The level of effectiveness and by-products should be considered when adopting a particular approach.

requirements.item_text: This waste documentation is kept at the manufacturing facility even when an external contractor is used.

mappings.quote: It is recommended that this documentation be maintained at the manufacturing facility regardless of whether or not an external contractor has been used.
